title: Engine-verified golden-suite position (one jsonl line) — see eval/EVAL-DESIGN.md §3 / §10.1

id.description: sha256(engine_sha,seed,swap,game_file,decision_index,category)[:16] — unique per line; same-decision candidates in different categories share the source block (replay address), never the id. game_file is salted in because (engine_sha,seed,swap) does not identify a game instance (reused seeds across matches; non-deterministic llm games)

controllers.description: e.g. ai/ai — must be deterministic for replay

seed.description: must lie in the reserved mining block (seed_policy.py)

prompt.description: verbatim user message the seat saw at the decision point

seed_block.description: name of the reserved eval seed block the source seed falls in (eval/seed_policy.py), when it falls in one; absent otherwise

excluded_from_sft_overlap.description: true iff source game contributed no row to any SFT dataset (required true for split=holdout)

status.description: absent = verified, for back-compat with pre-status suite files. 'candidate' = mined by eval/mine_puzzles.py, text-heuristic hypothesis, not yet engine-verified: no answer_key.

replayable.description: true iff both controllers of the source game are deterministic (floor/random/ai/ai-log), i.e. the position can be re-reached by the fork harness. false for llm-piloted games (candidates only, for heuristic tuning).

category_evidence.description: short human-readable summary of what the mining heuristic matched, e.g. 'own_power=7 opp_life=6' (mine_puzzles.py only)
